name: Lewis Anderson
source:
Edward was a temporary Greek instructor who worked briefly at Edward and Francis’s school during the time they were enrolled.

He is also an alumnus of the same school, a former prefect who was respected by many for his excellent academic achievements as well as his prowess in sports.

An extrovert who enjoys conversation, he is popular in high society due to his outgoing personality as well as his stylish and elegant sense of fashion.

He came across Edward by coincidence and assisted him in a case, which lead them to become reacquainted.

[From [url=http://studiopie.cafe24.com/eng/dear_edward] Official Website[/url]]
